description: Header file defining POSIX thread helper classes and functions for testing, including a semaphore implementation, thread management, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: TestSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore class using pthread mutex and condition variable for synchronization.

classes.name: WaiterContext
classes.description: A struct managing mutex and condition variables for thread waiting and signaling.

classes.name: TakeThenSignalContext
classes.description: An aggregate structure combining a semaphore and synchronization primitives for signaling.

classes.name: AbstractTestThread
classes.description: A base class for creating and managing threads in tests, requiring subclasses to override Run().

methods.name: TestSemaphore()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing permits to zero.

methods.name: TestSemaphore(int initial_thread_permits)
methods.description: Constructor initializing permits to a specified value.

methods.name: ~TestSemaphore()
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up mutex and condition variable.

methods.name: Put()
methods.description: Increments permits and signals waiting threads.

methods.name: Take()
methods.description: Blocks until permits > 0, then decrements permits.

methods.name: TakeTry()
methods.description: Attempts to decrement permits without blocking; returns success status.

methods.name: Wait()
methods.description: Waits on condition, increments waiters count, signals return condition.

methods.name: WaitForReturnSignal()
methods.description: Waits until unreturned_waiters > 0, then takes one.

methods.name: Run()
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be overridden by subclasses to define thread behavior.

methods.name: Start()
methods.description: Creates a new thread executing ThreadEntryPoint.

methods.name: Join()
methods.description: Joins the thread, waiting for its completion.

methods.name: GetThread()
methods.description: Returns the pthread_t handle of the thread.
